notes: CONTROL, NOT A RUN. Identical findings to scanner-2026-07-27-a, re-scored with score_scanner.py --alias-expand. Exists solely to make runs on either side of the vulnerability-class model comparable: without it, a post-change run wins partly by labelling consistently rather than by detecting more, and the two effects are indistinguishable. Isolates the alias axis: recall 31.6 -> 45.9 (+14 entries) and localization 44.9 -> 61.2 (+16 entries) with ZERO change to the findings themselves. Any future comparison spanning the class-model boundary must cite this line as the baseline, not scanner-2026-07-27-a. The residual gap to the 53.1/81.6 category-blind ceilings is the cross-class axis, which alias expansion cannot reach and multi-class emission targets.

Baseline for comparison is scanner-2026-07-27-a-aliasexpanded (recall 45.9, localization 61.2), NOT the raw 31.6 — otherwise the class model is credited twice. DETECTION IMPROVED, LABELLING DID NOT. Entries with no finding near the line fell 18 -> 9; file-level coverage reached 100%; category-blind localization rose 81.6 -> 90.8. Scored recall still fell 45.9 -> 41.8 because mislabelled entries rose 20 -> 30. All 30 had the correct class present in their lane's narrowed set, so narrowing caused none of it — the bottleneck has moved from detection to labelling. Cost fell 33% while findings rose 78%. DEFECTS IN FORCE: (1) five changes landed together — class model, route context, architecture context, reporting threshold, narrowing — so no single one is attributable; (2) architecture context had NEVER been delivered before this run due to a path-join bug, so the baseline is not a clean control; (3) the signal-to-class map is partly fitted to this benchmark, having been corrected after the pre-flight gate failed at 24/98; (4) precision proxy fell 24.9 -> 16.2 category-blind, the expected direction from the reporting threshold but an unmeasured magnitude; (5) LLM07 is absent from the scanner taxonomy while ground truth uses it; (6) A04 is marked uncertain by recon while being the largest category at 13 entries. Stage 1's projection was 1.94x the actual input — a calibration defect in the estimator, not in the run. Full detail in the private archive at runs/2026-07-27T18-01Z__stage0-2-v2-classmodel-narrowing__fb1c7ed.
